mapper.select: SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_PERSON_OWNER WHERE ID=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_PERSON_OWNER WHERE OWNER_PHASE_ID=#{phase} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_PERSON_OWNER SET OWNER_PHASE_ID=#{phase},UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{id} AND STATE='PREPARED' AND OWNER_PHASE_ID IS NULL

UPDATE SMT_AUTH_PERSON_OWNER SET STATE='INTENT',REQUEST_KEY=#{request},UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{id} AND OWNER_PHASE_ID=#{phase} AND OWNER_TOKEN=#{token} AND STATE='PREPARED' AND REQUEST_KEY IS NULL

UPDATE SMT_AUTH_PERSON_OWNER SET STATE='ACCEPTED',PERSON_ID=COALESCE(PERSON_ID,#{person}),UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{id} AND OWNER_PHASE_ID=#{phase} AND OWNER_TOKEN=#{token} AND REQUEST_KEY=#{request} AND STATE IN('INTENT','UNKNOWN') AND (PERSON_ID IS NULL OR PERSON_ID=#{person})
UPDATE SMT_AUTH_PERSON_OWNER SET STATE=#{state},REASON=#{reason},UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{id} AND STATE=#{old}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ID,PHASE,STATE,PERSON_ID,EXTERNAL_ID,REQUEST_KEY FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE WHERE INSTANCE_ID=#{p.instanceId} AND SUBJECT_TYPE=#{p.subjectType} AND SUBJECT_ID=#{p.subjectId} AND ACCESS_TYPE='ISC' AND (PHASE='ISC_PERSON' OR PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY ID) WHERE ROWNUM<=2
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_PERSON_OWNER WHERE INSTANCE_ID=#{instance} AND STATE IN('UNKNOWN','VERIFYING') AND ID>#{after} ORDER BY ID) WHERE ROWNUM<=#{limit}
